alias: Pool Simple Solar and Filtration - Commissioning
description: Lightweight HA controller; IntelliCenter Manual Bridge owns native writes. Solar starts/adoption require valid pool temperature below target and Solar/Eco Heat preference. End owned target-satisfied daytime sessions unless nighttime debt or independent circulation/safety authority applies. Five-minute Solar-loss trigger and Eco Heat recovery policy retained. Filtration credits verified Pool pump-running minute ticks, independent of equipment ownership; sole ledger rollover at 08:00. Automatic Ownership OFF yields equipment authority. Spa, sanitation, freeze, service mode and outage protection preempt schedule equipment commands. No RPM or persistent preset writes. Minute reconciliation recovers after HA reload/restart without blind startup replay. Manual ownership releases the schedule claim without equipment commands; delayed claims recheck current authority. Sanitation release event immediately reconciles normal pool authority without changing Automatic Ownership. Cold-weather manual Pool circulation is adopted for remaining filtration debt; when debt is already satisfied, preserve ten-minute manual service grace then release. Unowned native Pool starts receive ten minutes of service grace before ordinary commands. One restored manual-circulation marker distinguishes adopted filtration from Solar so debt, not roof/calendar or target satisfaction, terminates filtration-only circulation. Confirmed Solar promotion restores existing five-minute loss/thermal shutdown rules. Master OFF and all safety priorities remain authoritative.
